appearance_facts.fact: The blue line starts at the top of the plot, at the 2,800 gridline.
The line drops sharply to its lowest point, at the 2,400 gridline.
The line rises to its peak, slightly above the 2,800 gridline.
The line flattens out, remaining nearly horizontal just above the 2,400 gridline.
The overall trend shows a dip in 2019, a recovery to a peak in 2020, and then a plateau at a high level.
